rules.text: Returns in store require the Original Receipt or valid ID for many items.
rules.quote: If you purchased in store or online, just bring your item(s) with your Original Receipt to a checkout counter in any of our 1,000+ stores for your refund or exchange within the required time frame. No receipt? No problem! Many items can still be returned or exchanged in store with a valid ID.

rules.text: Office Supplies can be returned within 90 days if unopened and in original packaging.
rules.quote: Office Supplies 90 days Unopened, original packaging

rules.text: Ink & Toner can be returned within 30 days if unopened and in original packaging.
rules.quote: Ink & Toner 30 days Unopened, original packaging

rules.text: Technology & Electronics can be returned within 14 days in original packaging with UPC code and like new condition.
rules.quote: Technology & Electronics 14 days Original packaging with UPC code, like new condition.

rules.text: Furniture can be returned within 14 days unassembled and in original packaging with UPC code including all parts and manuals.
rules.quote: Furniture 14 days Unassembled and in original packaging with UPC code (including all parts and manuals)

rules.text: Software, CDs, DVDs & Video Games can be returned within 14 days if unopened; opened packaging can be exchanged for same item.
rules.quote: Software, CDs, DVDs & Video Games 14 days Unopened, original packaging. Opened packaging can be exchanged for same item.

rules.category: Office Depot® Brand Products excluding Ink & Toner
rules.text: Office Depot® Brand Products excluding Ink & Toner can be returned anytime.
rules.quote: Office Depot® Brand Products Anytime Excludes Ink & Toner

rules.text: Cleaning, Breakroom, Safety & Facility products are not returnable.
rules.quote: Cleaning, Breakroom, Safety & Facility Not returnable Includes COVID test kits, personal protective equipment, masks, face coverings, face shields, gloves, goggles, gowns, thermometers, and other related products

rules.text: Gift cards, Pre-paid & Phone cards are not returnable.
rules.quote: Gift cards, Pre-paid & Phone cards Not returnable Cannot be used to purchase other gift cards and are subject to the terms and conditions included with each card

rules.text: Technology products without Original Receipt are not eligible for return.
rules.quote: Technology products without Original Receipt are not eligible for return.
